info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-Delete Airline Flights Cancel-v1-spec
info.description: The Flight Cancellation API allows users to efficiently cancel existing airline flight reservations. By sending a DELETE request to this endpoint, customers can remove their bookings, ensuring that seats are released for other travelers. This API is essential for airline ticketing systems, travel agencies, and customer service platforms handling flight modifications. Typical consumers of this API include airline representatives and travel agents who need to manage bookings on behalf of their clients.

delete.description: This API endpoint allows you to cancel a specific flight booking. Ensure that you have the necessary permissions and that the booking is eligible for cancellation before making this request.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details required to cancel a flight. The payload should include the necessary information such as flight ID and any relevant cancellation details, ensuring that the flight can be correctly identified and processed for cancellation.

200.description: The cancellation request was successfully processed.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelRequest.description: A request body for cancelling a flight operation.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelResponse_200.title: Cancel Flight Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique identifier for the cancellation request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: Current state of the cancellation process.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cancellation in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the cancellation outcome.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelResponse_200.description: Response schema for the operation of canceling a flight.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the cancellation was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the cancellation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Contains information about the audit for the flight cancellation process.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time in milliseconds that the server took to process the request. This can help clients understand performance characteristics and latency of their operations.
